A '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]''' served as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed aboard [[Adamas Space Station]], which orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Around [[3642 BBY]], he carried several Imperial travelers to [[Dorn Base]] on the planet's surface.<ref name="TOR" />
